title: Corsair reports strong second quarter 2026 profit growth and cash generation
publisher: Corsair Gaming, Inc. via U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: Adjusted EBITDA was $30.8 million, including a $14.3 million tariff-refund benefit, and full-year adjusted EBITDA guidance increased to $121 million to $131 million.
summary: The SEC-filed issuer release supplies Q2 segment trends, tariff-refund normalization, cash generation, current product evidence, Trak Racer context and raised full-year guidance.
